title: An agent following the hub skill sends as "FYI" (--fyi) only what does not change the addressee's next step
note: The system prompt is plugins/hub-base/skills/hub/SKILL.md of the version. The inputs are `hub send --fyi` messages from the hub journal for 16–19.10 (27 of them), anonymized: a review, CI or QA result, a status change of the addressee's task, a request, an answer to what it is waiting for — `plain-*` (a normal message: --fyi waits until its next turn, and a mini-hub waiting for an executor takes a turn once in hours); a confirmation, an observation, a "thanks", a finished errand with no next step — `fyi-*`. Model and effort — as for hub sessions.

command.description: the exact `hub send …` command you run now to tell the addressee this

turns.input: You are agent gitlab: you watch GitLab — MRs, reviews, comments; to hub sessions — whatever concerns their MRs. MR !49 in the monolith repo is run by session maps (its task maps-41). The reviewer has just left a review: no remarks, approved the snapshot change, the pipeline is green. Tell maps this.

You are agent jira: you watch the tracker, move task statuses along after merge and rollout, colleagues' comments — to the session that runs the task. Task maps-60 is run by session auth. QA ran stage: ✅29 · ❌0 · 🔍1 manually (comment 41): switching between domains works. The QA STAGE → WFR move is done by QA; version 2.3 is already in prod. Tell auth this.

You are agent jira: you watch the tracker, move task statuses along after merge and rollout, colleagues' comments — to the session that runs the task. Task maps-60 is run by session auth. QA moved it QA STAGE → WFR, the code is in prod since version 2.3 — you moved it WFR → QA PROD and left a comment for QA. Next is the prod check QA → DONE. Tell auth this.

You are agent front: you run the frontend repos. Session ads is waiting for !22 to roll out (its task maps-86) and asked why the pipeline failed. You figured it out: the old pipeline 301 failed (a commit with a package, a private registry for CI); the next commit brought back the local type. The current pipeline 302: build, deploy, typecheck — success; only the optional test_branch is still running. The MR is approved, the task is in QA BRANCH. Tell ads this.

You are agent jira: you watch the tracker, colleagues' comments — to the session that runs the task. Task maps-75 is run by session svg-fix. QA sent a plan (comment 52) and 2 questions (53, they do not affect acceptance): attributes in single quotes are not recolored by the color parameter — a separate task or a known limitation? A string without an <svg> tag — what does it return? The session has to answer itself, with a comment in the tracker. Tell svg-fix this.

You are agent jira: you watch the tracker, move task statuses along. Task maps-61 is run by session verifier. Its MR !17 is merged (10:39), the tracker status is still CODE REVIEW — after the rollout to stage it has to be moved to QA STAGE (the session does that itself with a tracker command). Tell verifier this.

You are agent front: you run the frontend repos. Session ads asked earlier: "write to me when the tag with !21 and !22 goes to prod". Now v3.4 is in prod (deployed 08:40 UTC): it has !21 but NOT !22 — that one is still with QA. Tell ads this.

You are agent ads: you run ad campaigns. Session promo makes videos for the campaign and is waiting until they can be put in. All 6 videos are uploaded to prod and ready (07:00 UTC). You are the one who puts the videos into the live campaigns, after the site rollout — for that you need to know when the site tag goes out, and promo releases it. Tell promo this.

You are agent hub-dev: development of the hub core. Session ops (the server) wrote to you: "writes to the system disk are large — tools/test.py writes temp data to disk". You took it on: put an executor on it, and you will send the before/after write measurement yourself when you have it. Nothing is needed from ops now. Tell ops you have taken it.

You are agent teams: you run the owner's Teams. Session org (members and invitations to the organization on GitHub) earlier asked you to remind a colleague to accept an invitation — and you already told it "will do". You wrote to the colleague in Teams to accept the invitation. Session org does not need to do anything about it: the invitation is already sent, and it waits for the colleague's answer in GitHub. Tell org that you wrote.

You are agent recsys: recommendations and search. You noticed: since 13.10 the query "maps" on the collection page grew from ~65 to 270–365 people a day (ordinary browsers, there are results). Nothing is broken, nothing needs doing; if it is a site map change by session seo — let it just know. Tell seo.

You are agent hub-dev. Agent builder checked your cards to the owner and sent three points. The answer: p.1 — the rule is already in your file, no change needed, noted; p.2 — the owner's decision, not needed now; p.3 — noted. A second check on 21.10 — ok. Nothing is needed from builder. Tell it this.

You are agent backend. Earlier you opened MR !9 in agent builder's repo (a change about working copies) — it has not started reviewing it. You are closing the MR without merging: the owner said "no longer relevant". Nothing is needed from builder. Tell it.
